I posted the answer in #strategic-pod: Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group.

On Jul 1 he first posted 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 included sandbox logins from their May rollout. Ruth confirmed the corrected figure in the thread. The 280 is the active production roster count as of Jul 1, so it may have changed since then.
